note: Both sets are largely faithful and both are padded with near-duplicate claims (primary mirror diameter/thickness/material/open-back and the f/2.5 focal ratio appear 2–3 times each). Set A additionally captures the fine-steering-mirror residual pointing error (sub-milliarcsecond, with the FSM/beam-train condition kept) and the pointing requirement with its cameras/starshade condition, plus all five Figure 5.5-4 flight-system components correctly bound; Set B omits the FSM claim entirely and drops conditions on the pointing claim. Set B does pick up the scarfed straylight tube and the Figure 5.5-3 co-launch components that A misses, but its 22.8 m dimension is misbound to the 'HabEx telescope' as a length when the figure labels it for HabEx in the SLS (height), whereas A states that dimension correctly once. Net, A has more correct, better-conditioned claims and one fewer misbinding.
